bootstrap.workingDirectoryPolicy: Exact designated project deployment directory; other directories rejected
bootstrap.defaultMode: No-argument source-hash verification; does not import the CLI or authenticate
bootstrap.actualExecutionDesign: Separate hidden process runs the official cached CLI entry with a logging-only preload; normal CLI account selection, permission checks, API clients and deployment behavior remain in place

finding.detail: Normal CLI calls useFileLogger unconditionally, even without --debug; debug file deletion depends on normal exit
finding.secondaryDetail: Fetch-error debug serialization includes fetchOptions.body. OAuth refresh requests set skipLog for normal logging, but this exceptional path does not consult skipLog

mitigations: Disable file logger setup and debug methods before official CLI entry import
Reject debug, credential, discovery and secret-value environment overrides by key presence without printing values
Capture child stdout and stderr, including fatal and inherited predeploy output, without storing raw output
Emit only fixed lifecycle/error classifications, at most 32 unique records, with raw line buffering capped at 4096 characters
Preserve CLI exit code and require separate live configuration readback; CLI completion alone is not release acceptance
bootstrap.secretReview: Existing normal noninteractive ensureSecret path reads secret/version metadata; missing or disabled secrets fail. Secret-value access is a separate helper not called by that reviewed branch. This source review is not a live API trace.

chatSmoke.retryPolicy: Stop on first failed formatting, profile, context, model, transport or receipt-persistence check; no paid retry
verification: HTTP 200, source llm, matching request ID and approved-origin CORS
Bounded JSON response: exact canonical name and occupation from pinned offline resolver, plus requested scenario/year/time
Exact approved model allowlist when model is returned; an absent model is explicitly recorded unverified
Expected profile facts are never sent in the user prompt
No raw replies or session tokens are persisted; receipt contains check booleans and public profile fingerprints only
Exclusive attempt receipt is written before a paid request; an existing receipt forbids automatic replay
Fresh deployment readback required, including rejection of future-dated timestamps
chatSmoke.evidenceLimit: Response facts are bounded behavioral evidence, not a cryptographic API identity attestation. Source pins, resolver parity and deployment readback provide the separate binding evidence.

stagedSource.comparisonLimit: Local staged-source equality does not prove equality to the deployed revision or its effective runtime configuration

backendOfflineTests.deduplicationEvidence: Existing handler and quota tests verify duplicate-request handling; no live duplicate requests are made

remainingReleaseGates: Immutable asset publication and public byte-integrity audit
Fresh normal function metadata before deployment and exact after-deployment comparison of effective limits, identity and secret version references
Approved activation labels and revision with all traffic on latest revision
At most two normal live compatibility requests after deployment
Public browser validation after explicit runtime configuration activation
